meta.name: twitter-thread-creation
meta.description: Twitter/X thread writing with hook tweets, thread structure, and engagement optimization. Covers tweet formatting, character limits, media attachments, and posting strategies. Use for: Twitter threads, X posts, tweet storms, Twitter content, social media writing. Triggers: twitter thread, tweet thread, x thread, twitter post, tweet writing, thread creation, tweet storm, twitter content, x post, twitter writing, twitter hook, tweet formatting, thread structure

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 写出高互动的 Twitter 话题帖
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要持续产出有吸引力的 Twitter 帖子来提升影响力。
copy.tagline_en: Write engaging Twitter threads that boost interaction
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to consistently produce compelling Twitter threads to grow your influence.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你撰写和发布 Twitter/X 帖子与线程。它会生成钩子推文、结构化线程内容、添加媒体，并优化互动策略。
howto.when: 当你要求写 Twitter 线程、X 帖子、推文风暴，或提到“twitter thread”、“tweet storm”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个关于 SaaS 定价的 10 条推文线程。
say.note: Claude 会生成带钩子和 CTA 的完整线程。

say.text: 为这个线程生成一张标题图片。
say.note: Claude 会调用工具生成 1200x675 的图片。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you write and post Twitter/X posts and threads. It generates hook tweets, structured thread content, adds media, and optimizes engagement strategies.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to write Twitter threads, X posts, tweet storms, or mention keywords like "twitter thread", "tweet storm", etc.

say_en.text: Write a 10-tweet thread about SaaS pricing.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a full thread with hook and CTA.

say_en.text: Generate a header image for this thread.
say_en.note: Claude will use a tool to create a 1200x675 image.
